We Buy Your Gold, Silver & Precious Metals

Don’t let your gold sit idle. Whether it’s scrap gold from an estate sale, unwanted jewellery, coins, or bullion — we’ll give you a fair price based on current spot rates.

With precious metals prices at historic highs, now is an excellent time to sell.

  • Scrap gold and silver (any karat)
  • Gold and silver coins & bullion

  • Estate lots and collections

Sidney Antique Mall

20 Local Dealers Under One Roof

Step into the famous Sidney Antique Mall in the heart of downtown Sidney by the Sea. A vast and ever-changing selection of unique antiques, rare collectibles, and hidden treasures.

Our mall is home to numerous specialist dealers, each curating a diverse array of items — fine jewellery, art, memorabilia, man cave treasures, and architectural finds. New pieces arrive daily, ensuring a fresh experience with every visit.

Our knowledgeable and friendly staff are always on hand to help you discover that perfect piece or hidden gem.
